draft: From your window, you see a blue sky dotted with few clouds in this version of Mexico City where social harmony reigns supreme. People walk with smiles and chat amiably as they go about their day. Neighborhood groups gather regularly for community projects and mutual aid networks provide a foundation for small businesses. Economic activity buzzes but never at the expense of community well-being. However, gentrification is starting to push out long-time residents in some neighborhoods. Nonetheless, this utopian vision continues to thrive.
